reviews.text:
preparing 6 yr mini pinscher ( had been rescue puppy in Europe)  for travel overseas from
uk to australia.

received very helpful friendly service from vets David , clinical director, & travel vet Rebecca  ,OV66,  with checking health of our dog , filling in & submitting travel forms to relevant authorities , ( together with a different travel OV66 vet  for initial stages  )

received advice on feeding pet on vet recommended hyper allergenic sensitivity food & reduce weight .

very helpful friendly experienced receptionists who love pets , amber nadia & others on duty , only delay we had was with change of ownership on registering microchip with petlog for accurate  details &  foto.   eventually sorted by a fone call & helpful lady in uk centre manually inputting dog info & ours into petlog  database system . ( took 2 weeks & delayed blood testing ).

lovely premises St John's Wood NW London
free coffee tea water & dog treats .

easy to book appointments & reduce anxiety of pets & owners . our dog loves visiting .

thanks

highly recommend 5 stars

My Dog Bailey had an operation on his eye and some teeth removed, he is thirteen so we were concerned about the op , but all the veterinary staff were amazing, kept us updated all day throughout the process including photos so we could see how he was.
I cannot recommend them highly enough, Baileys making a full recovery and actually likes going there, which is a first for him, so nice to have found a vet that cares, 10/10.

I’ve been taking my two dogs to VET Alex in St John's Wood and highly recommend her. She is professional, knowledgeable, straightforward and always helpful when answering my questions. Her advice and treatment cleared up my French Bulldogs’ ear infections, and they haven’t had any further problems with their ears since.

How comfortable and kind the staff are at Creature Comforts in St John’s Wood. Today my dog went to have his knees looked at by David the nicest and most professional vet I have met. We were even offered a cup of coffee.  Do join us if you can it is the best bet for miles around

Can’t recommend this practice enough - my dog is  usually a nervous wreck whenever she goes to the vets ( that massive chain , you know the one ) but since switching to Creature Comforts she happily goes in . All of the staff really go out of their way to make sure  pets feel comfortable and lavish attention on them . It’s just a far nicer experience for pet owners too , the service feels premium too (  welcoming , appealing environment ) it’s competitively priced too without the stripped back provision you’ll find at the big chain .

First visit to Creature Comfort for our two cats’ annual vaccinations, their first since moving from abroad. The team replied quickly on the app beforehand. The waiting area was spotless and calm, with warm reception staff who happily helped with any questions I had.

Dr Oliver was kind and professional, listened patiently and gave honest advice on what’s realistic for our cats. When one of them got anxious and scratched me, the reception team kindly gave me antiseptic wipe and a plaster. It was a small gesture that meant a lot - thank you!

I'm very happy that our cats are in such good hands.

The reception area of creature comforts is very calming for owners and their pets the staff are relaxed and welcoming which is important.
My very reactive stray was almost serene thanks to the empathy and care shown by Grace the vetinary clinician. Thank you

There is something deeply rewarding about creating creature comforts for the animals we love. Over one year, I have developed a keen understanding of what helps pets feel safe, content, and cared for, from cosy spaces and gentle routines to attentive health care. Orly is at the centre of that world, and seeing him happy and thriving is always the greatest reward. I am also fortunate to have an amazing vet whose expertise, compassion, and dedication provide invaluable support. Together, we make sure Orly enjoys the comfort, care, and quality of life he deserves.
Fantastic service.

I visited this veterinary clinic for the first time today, and I couldn’t have received a warmer welcome. My dog was brought from abroad, and I was guided through every step of the process with great care and clarity.

The vet, Evie, was incredibly gentle, pleasant, and patient, which immediately put both me and my dog at ease. Everything was explained clearly and thoughtfully, and all my questions were answered without any rush. The receptionist, Amie, was very helpful and provided me with additional contact numbers to get my dog’s chip activated. She provided me with a few options for grooming services in the area.

The atmosphere was friendly, and I was truly happy with the level of service I received. I highly recommend this clinic and will definitely be returning.
Excellent staff calming atmosphere,understanding, highly recommend Lovely Vet! 👍👍👍👍👍Great with my dogs very gentle and caring.

Where do I start. Well here goes. Creature Comforts looked after my old boy Lhasa Apso Dougal before he became unwell and leading up to his passing most recently. All the vet docs I’ve had contact with are caring and personable and makes for a relaxed but professional environment, which I’ve not really experienced in all the years dealing with veterinary practices in previous years. I now have a gorgeous Imperial Shih Tzu pup who’s doing amazingly well and has ongoing checkups regularly, he’s happy and relaxed when we visit for his appointments. Oh and not forgetting front of house colleagues of Creature Comforts in St John’s Wood too. Cheers peeps …
Dr David and Andrea are amazing! My pup is always so happy to visit Creature Comforts

Finding a veterinary team you trust implicitly with your pet is rare, but the team here has earned that trust tenfold.
​From the second you walk through the doors, the front desk team sets the tone: warm, efficient, and genuinely happy to see you. But what truly sets this clinic apart is the exceptional level of medical care and compassion shown by the entire staff.
​Our dog, Rocky, usually gets nervous in clinical settings, but the  doctors handled him with such gentle patience that his anxiety vanished almost immediately. They took the time to let him get comfortable, met him at his level, and treated him like their own. The exam, every question was answered thoroughly, treatment options were explained clearly without rushing, and the follow-up care was seamless.
​It is clear that everyone working here has a true calling for animal care.
If you are looking for a dedicated, knowledgeable, and deeply compassionate vet team, look no further. Highly recommended!

My dog loves coming here (generous treat wall!!), and so do I. They have very consistent long-term staff, who really care and communicate well. It’s almost old fashioned in the sense of having a relationship and being known and recognized, which in today’s anonymous world feels quite revolutionary. Anyway, top reco from me (and nico 🐶). …

Extremely disappointing experience with front-desk chat support today. I fully respect clinical protocols regarding vaccine timelines, but the receptionist’s hostility and passive-aggressive attitude were unacceptable. Instead of professionally explaining the medical rationale (which another team member managed to do easily later on), she was condescending, gave evasive answers, and deliberately booked me for 9:00 AM despite me clearly requesting 3:00 PM. When I asked to escalate the issue to management, she simply went silent and ghosted the chat. A clinic should never weaponize administrative booking against pet parents. This encounter completely destroyed my trust, and I will not be renewing my membership.

The team at St John’s Wood is always fantastic — friendly, helpful, and genuinely welcoming, making you feel right at home. Storm and Pickle actually enjoy going there because they have a treat wall/area, which they absolutely love!

A really friendly welcome (coffee for me. Treats for my dog) and appointment was on time and really helpful and informative. Such a patient, lovely vet who took time and care to make Huxley feel at ease.
Great clinic with the nicest team ever! Everyone is super caring and kind :)

I can’t thank Creature Comforts enough for the care they gave my cat, Noah. From the very first emergency visit, when I was so worried, they were calm, kind, and professional. Dr. Bex was exceptional. She treated Noah with such warmth and patience, like a mother with her child. The whole team made me feel supported, and the atmosphere is always welcoming. Even after the dental procedure, the follow-up care was excellent. The monthly plan is great too. It really shows they care about making ongoing health accessible. I feel so reassured knowing Noah is in their hands.
The staff are really lovely. Ollie was out vet for Ruby and he was kind, calm and thorough.

They have dishonest practices that put the lives of pets in danger in order to make more money. I took my 5 year old cat to them for a one off problem and following an examination by hand they told me he might have a tumor in his stomach because they felt a “lump” and suggested investigating through an operation. I asked that they do non-invasive investigations first to confirm the tumor so he wouldn’t unnecessarily be put under. They wanted to then put him under anesthetiser for an ultrasound check which I again refused and insisted that the vets to hold the cat whilst scanning him with ultrasound without putting him under. When they followed through my instructions they found out that what they thought was a tumor were actually his kidneys which were functioning as normal. I ended up paying around £1200 to find that my cat has kidneys all the while trying to stop the vets from operating on him. Who knows what they would have come up with if I had let them operate on the poor cat. These discussions lasted several weeks all the while I was thinking my poor boy had cancer. I complained to their management and they said they will “investigate” but of course this is their common practice so there is nothing to investigate. Avoid them like a plague, they will put your pet’s life in danger for their financial gain!

I’m really happy with CC and all the staff that looked after and cared for Truffle. He was in the best hands from start to finish of his dental procedure. We have joined the membership when he was just a puppy and now he is nearly 2 years old. Thank you, you’re the best!

Absolutely the best vets we have been to and
Wish all vets like Grace and Rebecca and Evie and David and (  Alex who seems to be his favorite ) not forgetting the front of house team who are brilliant.  Looked after animals in the kind and caring way Creature comforts do
Thank you 😊 Leonard ( 5 chilli cat )

Such a differentiated experience from other vets.

The venue is relaxing and very clean, the staff are always polite and welcoming. Consultations are informative but not pushy and the plan is incredible value for money. The app works extremely well and there is generally good availability with the extended opening hours. Free treats and ad hoc events are a sprinkle on top

My little pommie Squirry was unwell experiencing bouts of nasal discharge, incessant and aggressive sneezing and not his usual energetic self. His condition became worse when he sneezed and discharged blood. I took him for an emergency visit and the vets recommended recommended a rhynoscopy should be conducted to check if there was something stuck in his nostril. Within two days the procedure was carried out by Rebecca who found a 3.5cm grass object embedded in hos nasal passage.  I would like to say a massive thank you to all the staff, they kept me updated by sending pictures and a video of the procedure, they also called to update me on additional procedures needed. Rebecca and the team are amazing. Thank you so much for looking after my baby boy. You guys are absolutely PAWSOME 😘🤩😗🤩

I have been with creature comforts since their doors opened in SJW and the team in there and particularly David who is the most caring, kind and considerate vet you could ever wish for !
I could not ask for nicer people look after my dogs !
Thank you Comfort Creatures 🙏

As much as my dog doesn’t like going to any vets I love going to the St Johns Woods branch.

They make such a fuss over Zeus which no one ever does cause of his breed but he is such a big softy at heart he just wants to lick everyone and everyone in this branch as soon as they see him they all want to say hello!

The staff are beyond amazing! Kat (Katarzyna) is just soo friendly and remembers a lot of the pets and their owners by name which when I have been there has been a lot of different animals but Kat is always so happy to see everyone, My favourite veterinarian is as I call her Dr Grace she is just so knowledgeable and understanding she has the patience of a saint cause I sometimes just get side tracked or just throw 100 questions at her but she is just so happy to see Zeus and see how much better he is getting within himself and even his skin. Dr Grace even communicates with me via email too cause if I forget anything or need some advice she is just there at the end of an email and the fact that she has patients to see and still takes the time out to email me back that same day just shows how above and beyond she goes as a veterinarian!
Best vets ever, my nervous dog is completely calm in there, lovely friendly staff who take time to go into detail so you’re not left feeling confused about anything. Could not recommend enough!

5 stars is NOT enough. If I could give this place a million stars, I would.

Our old vet shut down and I was panicked, as my sweet Pickle boy can be scared of new places. I read the reviews for this clinic and decided to give them a try. From the second we walked in and were greeted, I knew everything was going to be okay. Every single person who works here is a ray of sunshine.

I was so nervous about Pickle having his teeth removed. Not only did they call me with updates, they also sent pictures through the app, and I felt completely safe knowing he was in good hands. They also have the wonderful Pick and Mix treat wall, which, if your dog is food obsessed like mine, will have them forget they're even at the vet.

We do the £15 a month membership and it is worth every single penny. If you're in the North West and looking for a vet, I cannot recommend them enough.
Very nice people and a big cupboard of treats. There are even human treats at reception!

Stella my corgi suffered many episodes of vomiting and diarrhoea. Fortunately, the incredible team of Creature Comforts at SJW conducted a comprehensive step-by-step investigation. The final step was to rule out anything dangerous through a gastro endoscopy. The procedure was done smoothly, I got live chat updates and detailed pictures. Stella recovered very well and we were able to set a plan according to her needs.

My cat can get so nervous going to the vets but is so at ease here. The team really take their time to get to know you and your pet, and it never feels like a chore to come in. Jinx will be a client here for a long time to come!
Charlie had a dental surgery and he feels much more better now.Thanks
Great veterinary practice.  I highly recommend the practice.

Every one is so friendly and welcoming. The Vet was fabulous and explained everything during a 30 minute consultation and devised an action plan for Naoko. My dog was so relaxed in stark contrast to her previous vet. I would recommend this practice without a shadow of doubt.

Rebecca has been absolutely amazing with Rengar. She has taken such great care of him throughout his treatment and has been incredibly kind, professional, and reassuring. Thanks to her dedication and expertise, Rengar is making great progress with his mouth problems and is well on the road to recovery. We truly appreciate all the care and attention she has given him. I highly recommend Rebecca to anyone looking for a compassionate and knowledgeable veterinary professional. Thank you so much for everything!

My dog Ollie is always well cared for at Creature Comforts. He was a very nervous, reactive dog when adopted but team at CC were very good with him and he is  much more relaxed on visits now. He loves to get his purple ball 🟣 (basket at reception) every time we visit and I have been very happy with all his treatment and advice from vet, Evie,  Definitely recommend. Ollie does too. 🐾

Always very well cared for at creature comforts beautiful vet centre
I love my dogs vet she's so caring and my pet seems at ease with her wouldn't go anywhere else
Easy to book appointments no waiting around 5star vets
Lovely cup of coffee too .
Thank you all at creature comforts  x

A very caring and always helpful veterinarian practice.
Staff try their best to help clients with insurance claims etc and always accommodate my unwell cats in an emergency.

Creature Comforts were absolutely wonderful. It was our first visit and they made us feel very welcome. Our vet, Grace, was professional and thorough. The office staff were excellent too. 100 percent recommend.

Absolutely amazing staff/Vets. They are so, so caring and you can obviously tell, they all love animals. They all love my cat and she loves them too, even though she’s ALWAYS a bit shy at first. She knows they’re helping her really haha. It’s immaculately clean inside and I think the service and animal care is just amazing. 11/10. 🐈‍⬛
Excellent vet, friendly and caring staff
I love this place, they are not just a vets they are a community spot for people with pets. And if you need care for your pet that's where you want to be. The team is simply amazing 🤩
Such a lovely vets practice. Really friendly and caring staff and they provide such an excellent service. Very happy my darling cat is always in good hands.
Very friendly and knowledgeable team

I can't recommend Creature Comforts in St John's Wood highly enough. The team is incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and genuinely compassionate. They took the time to listen to all my concerns and made sure my kitten Nelly felt completely at ease. From a thorough check-up to reassuring me every step of the way, their care is outstanding and I always felt my boy was in safe hands. The clinic itself is modern and has a calming environment, which makes a huge difference for nervous pets. A special thank you to the whole team for their patience and expert care. If you're looking for a vet that truly cares, this is the place to go. Thank you, Creature Comforts!

Excellent vet, truly 5 start, I could put 6 stars if it would be possible. I took one of my cats to another vet as it was out of hours. Unfortunately she has passed away after mistakes of inexperienced vet at another practice. I wish I should never have taken her elsewhere as whole experience with Creature Comforts was excellent. Doctors at CC are very knowledgeable and truly love animals.

If you have a cat, don’t even think to take them elsewhere, stick to Creature Comforts.

I can’t thank Dr Rebecca enough for the wonderful care she gave my puppy, Cookie, during her laparoscopic spay surgery. From our first consultation, she was so kind, patient, and reassuring, taking the time to answer all of my questions and making me feel completely at ease.

The whole experience at the practice was outstanding. The clinic was spotless, calm, and welcoming, creating a reassuring environment from the moment we walked in. Every member of the team was warm, friendly, and genuinely caring, making both me and Cookie feel comfortable throughout our visit.

Leaving your puppy for surgery is never easy, but I knew Cookie was in the best hands. The procedure went perfectly, and she recovered incredibly quickly. In just couple of days, she was back to her happy, playful self, and her tiny incisions healed beautifully—you could barely see any sign of the stitches.

I’m incredibly grateful to Dr Rebecca and the whole team for their compassion, professionalism, and genuine love for animals. Their exceptional care has given me complete confidence, and I won’t hesitate to bring my second puppy, Toffee, back to Dr Rebecca when it’s time for his neutering.

Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my precious Cookie. I wholeheartedly recommend this practice to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.
My puppy is almost 4 month and the 3 time I have been there I was very satisfied they loved my Pandora
I was pleasantly impressed with the vet who treated my cat

CREATURE COMFORTS St John’s Wood is without a doubt the most professional and caring vets I have EVER known!💞💞💞

I sent this email to Dr Evie, Laura, Dr David and the team:

Dear Evie, David, Laura and Team;

This morning I did my normal walk in Regents Park. It’s the same walk I did with Cinka. I was in tears as you can imagine!

I came home to find the heart felt and extremely touching card that you sent to me with a file containing Cinkas hair and the beautiful paw & nose prints!

I have never known such a caring and considerate vets in my 64 years. ThankQ from the bottom of my heart!💙

I am planning to purchase another one or two Vizslas from the breeder in Hungary and this time I will have Insurance when I sign them with your wonderful vets.

I will be giving you a 5 ⭐️ Trust Pilot Review and on FB too.

Feel free to use this as a reference on your website. 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏
Kind regards

David xx

Came across This practice when they were dealing with an emergency which really impressed me. So much so I have joined their membership. I saw one of the vets for an initial Health check and they couldn’t have been nicer. I’m really comforted to have a local vet, open 7 Days a week that I can call upon at a moments notice if needs be.
Very friendly, comfortable vets . My Jesse felt very loved & relaxed . Never spent so much time discussing her health issues . Feeling very glad I moved vets to this one

A wonderful practice - kind team, Amber at the front desk just super efficient and lovely especially to my beagle Maya! Rebecca, David the vets we’ve seen are efficient, don’t recommend unnecessary treatments and explain things well. The pricing model is Ace! Highly recommend! Geeta
So caring and loving and Gatsby my Griffon  loves to visit and does not want to leave.

Amazing staff - truly fantastic and love animals. They were so kind to my pup. Used to go to village vet and so glad we changed

ETA - the dental nurse with red hair was pretty awful, not going to change my rating of the vet because everyone else is great but I was very unhappy with her behaviour and knowledge
Great service as always. Such lovely people a big thank you to Grace😊 for all her kindness to Baxter. …

I'm not usually someone who writes reviews, but on this occasion, I felt compelled to do so.
The whole experience from start to finish was absolutely exceptional. The clinic in St John's Wood is clean, modern, and designed in a thought out and mindful way that puts you at ease, you can really tell effort has gone into creating a space with a relaxing atmosphere and environment for both Pet and owner. Honestly, the waiting area felt like I was at a spa.

Every single member of staff I had the pleasure of meeting were welcoming, warm, and professional to a high standard.

My cat Mushka, needed an unexpected emergency operation, which was carried out during the out of hours service. Rebecca, who performed the procedure on my cat, made me feel reassured and at ease, as concerned I was at the time. She explained everything in great detail and went above and beyond to help save my cat. The proceedure was a success and my cat Mushka has had plenety of post op visits just to make sure her recovery was keeping on track. Mush is a house cat and so she can be very timid around unfamiliar people, she does not like being outdoors either and she gets very stressed by loud noises so, I was very plesently surprised by how well she handled the vet. I explained this with Rebbeca and she was so lovely and patient towards Mush and even offered her lots of treats and affection ! You can really see how passionate and genuine the staff are here. You can see that they really do care for the animals that come in and that they work with compassion.

Prior to Creature Comforts, I first took Mush to a well established Vet within the area, however, they frustratingly misdiagnosed her with a UTI, this place was a smaller clinic compared to Creature Comforts and so they didn't have the substantial equipment to properly investigate the issue with my cat, unfortunately that was all that was available at the time.
When arriving back home her condition got worse and she started to deteriorate rapidly, that's when I decided to take Mush to Creature Comforts for the first time, and thank god I did !

Creature Comforts were able to diagnose my cat straight away and fast! which meant she got the urgent care she desperately needed. I am now happy to report that Mushka has made a full recovery in a matter of weeks and is back to her bright self ! I am honestly so relieved and overjoyed by her recovery.

Exceptional service with honest rates and more affordable in comparison to other clinics in the area. They are transparent and upfront with costs from the beginning. I could not recommend Creature Comforts enough. 5 stars ! (I would put 6 if it was possible)

Thank-you to Rebecca and all the lovely staff at Creature Comforts,
From Mush and Me.

What a breath of fresh air compared to our woeful experience at the two Camden vets we had endured previously! Creature Comforts is truly the Rolls Royce of vets but at Ford Fiesta prices - go for a test drive like we did and I guarantee you won't be disappointed by their performance!
Amazing vets. Friendly stuff . My dog loves visiting

Dr. Evie is absolutely wonderful! It is so clear how much she truly loves animals. She treats my giant four legged friend with so much gentleness and kindness, which makes our vet visits completely stress-free. She is patient, takes the time to answer all my questions, and provides top-tier care. I trust her and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a fantastic vet!
Absolutely brilliant

WOW!!! What a difference, first time visit and we are amazed by how great this Vet Practice is, the reception was so welcoming and helpful and the Vet, Grace, was so thorough and careful with our dog. The consultation was so good we signed up for the annual plan and Ted  (our Cockapoo) is looking forward to his follow up visit!

I wish we had joined earlier! This is how all Vets should be!

Absolutely great experience. The team took great care of my dog during his neutering procedure and kept me informed throughout with updates and photos. Everyone was kind, professional, and genuinely caring. The waiting area is also lovely, with treats, fresh water, and even balls available for dogs, which is a really thoughtful touch. Thank you for looking after Leo so well, highly recommended!

Hi Maria, thank you for your review. We take all feedback seriously and would like to find out a bit more, but unfortunately we're not able to track down your details in our system. We'd really appreciate it if you could email us at hello@creaturecomforts.co.uk so we can follow up with you. Thanks again, and we hope to hear from you soon!
Hi Gerard, thank you so much for your 5 star review, we really appreciate it!

Creature Comfort is a great clinic as well as Animal understanding. My cat felt so comfortable with the doctor and took vaccine in a calm matter as as other treatments.i personally think she enjoyed being at the clinic and trusted the surroundings, although she normally freaks out of any stranger.
I would recommend this Clinic to anybody who loves his or her pet

Had my 1st experience visiting Creature Comforts in St John's Wood with my newly adopted cat Charlie. From the moment we walked in the staff were friendly,  welcoming,  caring and very knowledgeable. We saw Dr Evie who gave Charlie his vaccination. She was very patient with him which was very appreciated by myself and my daughter. The reception staff even had a little goodie bag ready for Charlie to take home. 💜💜💜
Wonderful help for our cat Gwen and a very good  approach including membership
Such lovely staff & very helpful! Definitely would suggest getting the membership it’s so worth it!
Great care for our puppy, healed well and quickly post procedure

Rebecca is just amazing. Truly committed to the well being of the animals before all else. She saw Rocco through an eye ulcer - keeping him comfortable and achieving results with light operational intervention. She has a good balance of natural healing / surgery. She also tackled the main cause and dealt with Rocco’s ears / allergies. Thank you Rebecca!
Second time going to a creature comfort clinic, both Notting Hill and St John’s Wood branch are great and the people who work there were very helpful and nice

Excellent attention and care was payed to my dog by doctors and all staff members. We’ve been making weekly visits as my young pup needs a lot of medical care at the moment and I’m so grateful to have Dr. David and the team there to care for her. My dog enjoys going to the vet and associates it with positive experiences and treats thanks to the free pick’n’mix dog treats and tennis balls on offer. Highly recommend them to anyone with a pet in the area.
Hi Anton, thank you so much for the 5 star review! We hope you and Dante are well! Please pop in anytime for a treat visit!

Creature Comforts in St John's Wood is FAB!. Even the doggie patients like to go in there. Reception is always with a smile and extremely friendly. Doggies get treats. Vets are very, very nice and the facilities are 2nd to none.

This veterinary practice is absolutely brilliant. Every time I’ve contacted them regarding my dog, they have been so supportive, understanding, and helpful.

A special mention has to go to the Head Vet Nurse Amy,  who consistently goes above and beyond with her help, advice, and reassurance. Nothing ever feels like too much trouble, and her care and compassion really stands out.

I do worry quite a bit when it comes to animal welfare, but this practice is always there to support and guide me, which gives me so much peace of mind. I’m incredibly grateful for all the care and kindness they continuously show — highly recommend!

First time visiting a creature comforts branch, honestly regret not using these guys before, it is the best vets by far in the UK. We have been to many local private vets over the years and none compare (not even close) to the standards at creature comforts. Customer services and facilities are also the best i have seen.

My dog Rex is now almost 3 weeks post-BOAS surgery and I honestly cannot thank the team at Creature Comforts enough for the incredible care they have given him. Rex is 4 years old, but we have only had him for around 10 months. From the moment we got him, it was obvious he was struggling with his breathing. His snoring was so loud that it would keep myself and my children awake at night and even simple walks were difficult for him. At the park, he wouldn’t stop to sniff trees or explore like other dogs, he would walk for around 5 minutes and then stop, heavily breathing and wanting to go home. Rex is still only allowed very short walks while he recovers, but even now, the difference is incredible. On a gentle 10-minute walk around the park, he is now happily stopping to sniff trees and explore, which he had genuinely never done before.
Rex also had his nostrils widened during surgery, and that alone has made such a huge difference. Dr Penny did such an amazing job, he still looks just as gorgeous as he did before, just with a much happier and more comfortable little face! A huge thank you to Dr Penny, who carried out Rex’s surgery. She was so thorough, reassuring, and took the time to explain everything to us in detail, including what to expect during recovery. I also want to say a special thank you to Vet David and Vet Keke, who have both been absolutely wonderful during Rex’s recovery. Their aftercare has been amazing, and they have both kept such a close eye on him during those first difficult couple of weeks post-surgery.
The reception team at the St John’s Wood branch are also always so kind, caring, welcoming, and genuinely lovely with Rex.
Rex is a French Bulldog cross Shar-Pei, so he really is a perfect example of a dog that struggled badly with breathing difficulties. Creature Comforts have said themselves that he is an amazing before-and-after case study for BOAS surgery because the difference has been so significant already.

If Google allowed video uploads in reviews, I would happily share Rex’s before-and-after videos. Creature Comforts have these videos, and I would be more than happy for them to share them with future BOAS owners who may be feeling nervous or unsure about surgery like I was, because seeing the change in Rex has been absolutely incredible.

Thank you again to everybody at Creature Comforts for everything you have done for Rex!

Absolutely brilliant vets - friendly, caring and professional.

I’ve got two Flatcoated Retrievers and Rebecca and the team always look after them so well and make every visit a positive experience.

Highly recommended.

I cannot recommend this vet practice highly enough. When my dog, Aki, was a puppy, she faced complex medical issues that were incredibly stressful for us as owners. The entire team stepped up with an exceptional level of responsibility, professionalism, and genuine care.
During a particularly difficult time when Aki had to stay in the ward for one day observation, the team went above and beyond to keep us at ease. We received constant updates and videos of her, which provided immense comfort when we needed it most.
A special, heartfelt thanks goes to Dr. Rebecca. Her patience and guidance have been invaluable. She introduced a crucial diet for Aki that completely turned things around, finally putting Aki on a normal, healthy growth track.
If you are looking for a veterinary team that treats your pets like family while delivering top-tier medical expertise, this is the place to go. Thank you all for everything you’ve done for Aki!

The most compassionate team of doctors.I have been visiting the clinic at St.Johnswood since we got our pup and just so happy with the entire set up.The doctors are knowledgeable,proactive and everything is seamless.Our dog loves his visits there too.Would highly  reccomend this clinic.

Creature Comforts St Johns Wood is an excellent vet practice with exceptional staff - the vets, vet assistants and reception staff. My dog is always extremely well cared for (and spoilt!) at every visit. Most recently she had an emergency operation under the care of Dr Rebecca and supported by Dr Kiekie who both did a wonderful job. She also regularly sees Dr David. I would recommend this vet wholeheartedly to anyone who is seeking care for their dog or cat!
Matcha loves coming to the vet !!! Best service and the most loving and caring vets and nurses 🤍 …

Absolutely wonderful and knowledgeable team at St.Johns Wood. Love how welcoming the practice and staff are aswell as very compassionate. From the moment we walked into Creature Comfort (St John’s Wood), we knew we were in the best hands. The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, and every member of the team goes out of their way to make both pets and owners feel at ease.

We have an Australian Labradoodle, Yoshi, who can be quite nervous, and we’ve had to visit regularly due to suspected allergies and ongoing anal gland issues. Each time, Dr Grace has been nothing short of exceptional—patient, gentle, and genuinely caring. She takes the time to listen to every concern and always finds solutions that truly work, while keeping Yoshi’s wellbeing at the centre of everything she does.

What really speaks volumes is that Yoshi actually loves coming to the vet and gets excited to see Dr Grace and the team—something we never thought we’d see!

The front desk staff are just as incredible. Amy, in particular, has been so helpful with every query, especially when supporting us through an insurance claim during Yoshi’s procedure for a sedated anal gland flush. Throughout that time, Dr Grace and the team kept us fully updated, even sending photos, which made a stressful situation so much easier.

This team consistently goes above and beyond, and we couldn’t be more grateful. We wholeheartedly recommend Creature Comfort and especially Dr Grace—she truly is an outstanding vet.

I recently took my cat to Creature Comforts in St John’s Wood, and it was genuinely the best experience I’ve ever had with a vet.

From the moment I walked in, everything felt calm, professional, and well-organised. The staff were incredibly friendly and actually took the time to listen, which made a huge difference. You can tell they genuinely care about the animals and aren’t just rushing appointments through.

The vet was thorough, patient, and explained everything clearly without making it feel overwhelming. My cat was handled so gently, and the whole visit felt stress-free compared to what I’ve experienced elsewhere.

I was previously registered with Snoots, and the difference is night and day. Creature Comforts go above and beyond in terms of care, communication, and overall service.

I honestly wouldn’t go anywhere else now. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet who truly puts your pet first.
